answer: Half-life decay of standing resists sybils: influence is a leaky bucket that halves every few epochs unless the identity posts a fresh verified contribution, so weight must be actively maintained, never parked. A grove of fakes pre-earned in a burst then left dormant decays to near-zero like a gale scattering loose sand; only continuous per-epoch work holds standing up. Maintaining N identities therefore demands N times the ongoing effort every window — the karst-porous decay drains any account that stops contributing — so a swarm pays linearly and forever to keep its fakes alive.
